Statue Square.en: A public square beside the former Supreme Court building, named for the royal statues that once stood in it.
Statue Square.zh-CN: 紧邻旧最高法院大楼的公共广场，因昔日立在此处的王室雕像得名。

HSBC Main Building.en: A bank headquarters designed by Norman Foster, opened in 1985; its ground floor is an open public passage.
HSBC Main Building.zh-CN: 诺曼·福斯特设计的银行总部，1985 年启用，底层是开放的公共通道。

Bank of China Tower.en: A 367 m tower by I. M. Pei, completed in 1990, braced by a triangular frame.
Bank of China Tower.zh-CN: 贝聿铭设计的 367 米高楼，1990 年落成，外露三角形桁架结构。

Lippo Centre.en: Twin office towers of 1988 by Paul Rudolph, with stepped glass bays on every side.
Lippo Centre.zh-CN: 保罗·鲁道夫设计的双塔写字楼，1988 年落成，四面是层层外挑的玻璃体块。

Central Pier Number 8.en: A harbourfront pier, home of the Hong Kong Maritime Museum since 2013.
Central Pier Number 8.zh-CN: 海滨码头，2013 年起是香港海事博物馆所在地。

Two International Finance Centre.en: A 412 m office tower on reclaimed harbour land, completed in 2003.
Two International Finance Centre.zh-CN: 建在填海土地上的 412 米写字楼，2003 年落成。

Jardine House.en: A 1972 office tower known for its rows of round windows; the tallest building in Hong Kong when it opened.
Jardine House.zh-CN: 1972 年落成的写字楼，以一排排圆窗闻名，启用时是香港最高的建筑。

The Center.en: A 346 m office tower completed in 1998; bands of coloured light run up its crown at night.
The Center.zh-CN: 1998 年落成的 346 米写字楼，夜里塔顶有一圈圈变色灯光。
